prompt:
Create a PRODUCTION GAME SPRITE ATLAS on a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, for a 2D side-scrolling Sun Wukong Heavenly Palace action game. The reference image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE only; do not reproduce its scene or HUD.
Layout is STRICTLY 4 columns x 2 rows, EIGHT equal square cells in a wide 2:1 overall canvas. Each cell has EXACTLY ONE FULL BODY sprite, ALL sprites facing RIGHT, centered horizontally in their own cell. No labels, no text, no borders, no shadows, no ground, no background props, no UI, no floor. Very generous padding, absolutely no limbs or feathers extending into another cell. ALL FEET are at 90% of their cell height, all content is contained within the central 80% of the cell width. Render at maximum high resolution.
Premium hand-painted Chinese arcade fantasy sprites, dark fine ink outlines and clean silhouettes, gold and jade details, moderate material shading, visually clear as small game characters. Match the reference Wukong gold lamellar chest armor, red flowing scarf and red sash, dark teal trousers, monkey face and golden-brown fur, long curved monkey tail, gold crown with TWO long thin curved pheasant feathers.
CRITICAL: the four Wukong sprites must have EMPTY HANDS and NO STAFF/WEAPON of any sort. Their elbows bent, both hands extended in front of the waist as if gripping an INVISIBLE horizontal pole at lower chest height. The engine draws the moving golden staff separately. No swords, no staff, no rods anywhere in top row.
Top row, four CONSISTENT SAME SIZE WUKONG full body sprites:
cell 1 idle ready stance, legs planted apart.
cell 2 running stride A, right knee forward, left leg behind.
cell 3 running stride B, left knee forward, right leg behind.
cell 4 airborne tucked legs jump pose, scarf and long tail curved upward; center body at same height as others, feet anchor same cell baseline.
BOTTOM ROW: cells 1-3 are ordinary heavenly soldiers of same BODY HEIGHT as Wukong's torso-to-foot height, silver-and-blue lamellar armor, white helmet crests, pale-blue trailing ribbons, human faces.
bottom cell 1 celestial SPEAR GUARD in advancing ready pose, long spear angled up so it fits entirely in square cell.
bottom cell 2 celestial SHIELD GUARD, round blue-silver cloud-pattern shield forward and short spear behind shield.
bottom cell 3 celestial CLOUD CROSSBOW GUARD with small compact traditional Chinese crossbow aimed slightly downward; white cloud under feet SMALL enough to fit in padding.
bottom cell 4 Ju Ling Shen giant BOSS, one full body dignified heavily built bearded male celestial general, heavy silver and deep-blue engraved armor with gold edges, big white helmet crest, broad ceremonial axe held up at diagonal beside him. Draw his complete sprite to same cell frame height as the others (game will scale him larger). No horns or wings.
Exactly EIGHT sprites in EIGHT separate equal cells, all full body visible with clear transparent separation. Style and faces anatomically refined, not chibi, not stick figures, not pixel art, no watermarks.
